texts: good. the twelve-person party with its count, the departure, Aelmere as the place left, and sundown are all recorded. One caveat that is ours rather than yours: 'day 33 of Year 1' lands on the calendar terms (Day 33) + (Year 1), and (Day n) is the day-of-month slot, so 'day 33' is not a well-formed calendar day — day-of-year/era dating has no licensed term yet, and no rewrite on your side would fix it.

mixed: the leading, the party, the goat-path and the destination are all present, but two things are off. 'Along the goat-path' is recorded as Instrument, which claims the path was the means of the leading rather than the route taken — a translator-side slot error (the licensed form is the surface preposition, Along), so nothing in your wording caused it. What your wording can fix is the destination: 'the Salt-bloom Tide-pools' is a plural proper name, and our name rules cannot take a kind from the label word of a plural, so the parse says nothing at all about what the place is. Naming the kind beside the name fixes that: 'Sailsworn led the harvest party along the goat-path to the Salt-bloom Tide-pools, a group of tide-pools.'

mixed: both tool sets are recorded as carried and 'wooden scrapers' decomposes correctly, but the parse also asserts that a copper bucket is an instance of the metal copper — a false atom, since 'copper' here is a noun modifier and our rules bar exposing those (steel_beam is not steel). That is purely a translator-side slip; no rewrite of yours would avoid it, so keep the sentence as written. One thing still undecided on our side: your two coordinated objects landed as one carrying event with two Theme atoms rather than two replicated events — faithful either way, but we have not yet settled which shape is canonical.
good. the comitative 'with the harvest party' is recorded as a co-participant rather than as a means, and Coraline Ash and the party reuse the passage's symbols.

good. 'each member of the harvest party' becomes a fireable per-member rule over the party's members, each with its own assigned pool, the five pools carry their count and their containment in the Tide-pools, and 'blooming' distributes to the individual pools instead of riding the group symbol. Worth knowing: that rule stays dormant until some sentence states that a particular person is a member of the harvest party, and this passage never does — so nothing fires for Coraline Ash here.

good. the assignment, Coraline Ash, the pool and its link back to the five-pool group are all recorded, and the rank is kept as an ordinal on a north axis. That axis filler is an improvisation — our ordinal scale slot is defined for an associated event or an '-est' dimension, not a compass direction — so the atom is true but its exact shape may change once we cover spatial ordinals; no rewrite needed.
